Easy Quran – Read, Listen & Understand with Clarity
Easy Quran is a thoughtfully designed digital Quran that helps you read, listen, and understand the Quran with ease. It brings together Arabic text, Urdu translation, English translation, and high-quality Tilawat in a clean and comfortable reading experience. Whether you prefer simple reading, listening during your day, or studying meanings in depth, Easy Quran provides a calm and reliable environment for your Quran journey.

The app offers IndoPak script, translation, tafseer, synchronized audio, Ayah-by-Ayah support, and smooth navigation across all 114 Surahs. You can also download Surahs for offline use, bookmark important ayahs, search across Surahs and personalize your reading experience with themes and font adjustments. Everything is organized to make the Quran accessible and easy to follow.

Key Features
• Quran with Urdu & English Translation
Read the full Quran with clear and authentic Urdu and English translations. The app supports high-quality Arabic scripts with excellent readability, making it comfortable for daily recitation and study.

• HD Tilawat by Multiple Qaris
Listen to recitation from well-known reciters in high-quality audio. Arabic recitation and translation audio can be played together with synchronized text for effortless follow-along.

• Auto-Scroll While Listening
Enable auto-scroll to allow the app to move through the ayahs automatically as the recitation continues. Ideal for hands-free reading or memorization practice.

• Full Offline Mode
Surahs are available for offline use so you can read anytime, even without an internet connection.

• Bookmarks, Notes & Last Read
Save ayahs for later, add personal reflections, and return instantly to your last reading position. Your progress stays organized and easy to access.

• Themes & Reading Customization
Switch between light and dark themes, adjust font sizes with change line spacing to suit your comfort.

• Ayah Sharing
Share Arabic text, Urdu translation, or English translation directly with others. The app formats ayahs neatly for easy sharing.

• Tafseer Access (Where Available)
Open tafseer to explore explanations and background context for selected verses.

• Topic-Based Ayah Classification
Browse ayahs grouped under meaningful themes such as Faith, Worship, Character, Family, Society, and more. This helps users learn and understand the Quran in a structured way.

• Clean and Distraction-Free
